data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2088 reported a modest prior-year release of GBP 1.1m for 2016, arising wholly from runoff/reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003. The release reflects favourable prior claims experience and reinsurance-related movements on quota share arrangements; no gross prior-year movement was explicitly stated in the notes, so the published net runoff release has been used.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 1.1m (2015: run-off deviation of GBP 0.4m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.

The syndicate incurred a net loss ratio of 65.4% (2015: 66.0%). The improvement in the loss ratio is primarily due to the change in contract terms on the XL Catlin Syndicate 2003 quota share contract in 2015, which previously specified that premium is ceded net of acquisition costs. During 2015, a higher proportion of earned premiums were reported net of acquisition costs than during 2016. The improvement to the loss ratio arising from this change is offset by the challenging rating environment and larger catastrophe losses during 2016.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: the note explicitly states a run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m but does not present a gross (insurance liabilities) movement figure. A gross claims development triangle is present (note 6) but parsing and use as a primary gross PYD source was avoided due to potential distortion from reinsurance/quota-share restatement described elsewhere in the notes. Therefore the reported prior year movement is the net run-off release as stated in the movement note and is flagged as NET of reinsurance since no gross movement was clearly presented.
